2026-MO-SCRET-1.note: Judge of the Supreme Court (retention vote). Kalshi's event is titled "Will Paul Wilson be retained on the Missouri Supreme Court?" Its one row is labelled "Yes", not a name, so the page's matching of rows to names would not place it. Ask John before showing this market. Polymarket lists no market for this race (its search for Missouri and the likely slugs, 2026-10-02).
